tasks.short: Explain site cost and revenue trends and prepare the financial outlook with FP&A.

today.trigger: A forecast round, investment proposal or management question about Rotterdam, Tilburg or Venlo.
steps: Export financial actuals and commitments from AFAS and retrieve the latest approved forecast.
Collect explanations from site managers and obtain staffing costs and operational drivers where available.
Clean mappings and compare revenue, labour, agency spend and other costs in Excel.
Project revenues and expenses, checking assumptions with FP&A and the Controller.
Prepare a short explanation of the outlook, uncertainties and recommended actions.
drudgery: Rebuilding the same site and account mappings.
Copying actuals into forecast workbooks.
Chasing explanations and reconciling different workbook versions.
today.time_sinks: Finding consistent inputs and explaining differences between accounting actuals, agency commitments and operational assumptions.

lenses.faster: Reconcile AFAS actuals and approved commitments automatically, then draft a source-linked variance explanation. Repeated exports, mapping and spreadsheet assembly disappear.
lenses.autonomous: After the nightly extract passes reconciliation checks, refresh the outlook and flag material changes. Ask managers only for missing assumptions or unexplained movements.
lenses.ambitious: Produce a rolling site outlook every week, including agency labour and cash implications, if the underlying operational data supports it.
lenses.joy: Remove workbook repair and repeated requests for figures. Keep the conversations about why costs moved and what the business can change.
lenses.options: Compare base, peak-volume and downside cases with different agency hours, rates and customer volumes. Show which assumptions change the result most.
lenses.altitude: Own the forecast reconciliation rules, assumption register and explanation quality instead of assembling every analysis.
reach: FP&A: prepare reconciled actuals and first-pass forecast scenarios.
Controller: maintain a financial commitments register.
Site management: quantify proposed staffing and spending changes.

tasks.human_edge: Judge whether commercial and operational assumptions are credible, challenge managers and explain uncertainty without presenting a scenario as a promise.
tasks.pattern_why: Several sources and follow-up questions are involved. Deterministic calculations should produce the numbers; an LLM can draft explanations, with human approval of assumptions and advice.

in_practice.trigger: A validated nightly AFAS extract arrives during a forecast cycle, or an accountant requests a scenario.
steps: Check extract freshness, reconcile totals to AFAS and apply versioned site and account mappings.
Combine approved commitments and operational assumptions, clearly marking unavailable or estimated inputs.
Calculate the outlook and scenarios using controlled formulas.
Draft explanations linked to source figures and route unanswered questions to the accountant.
After approval, save the forecast version and publish the agreed analysis.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant and FP&A approve assumptions and explanations; the Controller or Finance Director approves the official forecast under existing authority.
data_needed: Actuals by period, site and account.
Approved forecast versions and mapping tables.
Open commitments and agency hours and rates.
Operational volumes and pricing assumptions where available.
Materiality thresholds and named assumption owners.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint forecast register containing source timestamps, model versions, assumptions, exceptions and approvals.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports scheduled refresh, financial measures and comparisons across sites and periods.
Controlled calculations and source-linked drafting could reduce repeated forecast preparation.
The proposed workflow, 60% time saving and 2.5 times speedup are untested estimates for Noordhaven.

risks: The nightly extract cannot support claims about today's transactions.
Missing operational volumes or incomplete commitments can make projections misleading.
Generated explanations may invent causes unless each causal claim is confirmed.
Detailed payroll and customer data require restricted access and an approved processing arrangement.
research_questions: Can AFAS actuals and commitments be reconciled by site without manual mapping repairs?
Which operational drivers exist, who owns them and how current are they?
Does a pilot reduce total preparation and review time while preserving forecast accuracy?
Which responsibilities belong to the accountants versus the two FP&A Analysts?

tasks.short: Find control gaps, duplicate spending and unusual transactions, then investigate the exceptions.

today.trigger: A periodic control review, audit request or suspicious transaction.
steps: Collect ledger entries, invoices, supplier changes, payment information and relevant policies.
Compare records in Excel for duplicates, unusual amounts and missing approvals.
Trace selected exceptions to documents and ask process owners for explanations.
Assess whether the evidence shows an error, control weakness or matter requiring escalation.
Document findings, agree corrective actions and follow up.
drudgery: Downloading and joining transaction files.
Checking the same duplicate patterns repeatedly.
Assembling supporting documents and chasing action updates.
today.time_sinks: Separating genuine exceptions from harmless differences and obtaining evidence of who approved what.

lenses.faster: Run repeatable checks across all accessible transactions and assemble evidence for each exception. The accountant starts with a ranked investigation queue.
lenses.autonomous: Run checks after each validated extract and route exceptions by value, control and owner. Track unresolved items and escalate overdue actions.
lenses.ambitious: Move from occasional samples to continuous coverage of duplicate invoices, supplier bank changes, split purchases and agency invoice mismatches.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated spreadsheet comparisons and document hunting. Keep the investigative work and discussions that improve processes.
lenses.options: Compare strict and broad detection thresholds before deployment. Show the workload and missed-case tradeoff using previously reviewed exceptions.
lenses.altitude: Design and tune the control library, assess coverage and measure whether corrective actions prevent recurrence.
reach: Bookkeepers: provide duplicate-invoice checks before posting.
Controller: maintain control evidence and remediation tracking.
Procurement and site managers: identify recurring approval and purchasing weaknesses.

tasks.human_edge: Distinguish suspicious patterns from misconduct, handle sensitive investigations fairly and judge whether evidence supports escalation.
tasks.pattern_why: Rules can detect many exceptions and an LLM can extract document fields, but investigation and conclusions require judgment. A flagged pattern must never become an automatic fraud finding.

in_practice.trigger: A validated transaction extract arrives or a targeted investigation is opened.
steps: Load permitted transactions and approval evidence, reconciling counts and totals.
Run versioned rules for duplicates, unusual supplier changes and policy exceptions.
Extract relevant document fields and assemble a source-linked evidence pack.
Let the accountant dismiss, investigate or escalate each material exception.
Record agreed remediation and monitor its completion.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant validates findings; the Controller or Finance Director authorizes sensitive investigations and consequential action. No automated accusation, payment block or employee sanction.
data_needed: Invoice headers and lines, ledger entries and payment references.
Supplier master changes and approval logs where available.
Agency hours, agreed rates and invoices.
Purchasing policies, control rules and previously resolved exceptions.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted control register with rule versions, source references, dispositions, reviewer identity and corrective actions.

evidence.claim: Duplicate and policy checks can be implemented as deterministic comparisons over structured transactions.
Power BI can present exception queues and control trends from prepared data.
The proposed workflow, 50% time saving and two times speedup require a local pilot.

risks: False positives can damage trust and overload investigators.
Incomplete approval history can make a compliant transaction appear suspicious.
Employee monitoring requires an AVG/GDPR assessment and assessment of applicable OR consent rights; a DPIA may be required.
Any extension into employee evaluation or sanctions needs a separate EU AI Act scope assessment.
research_questions: Are supplier changes and approval histories available with reliable timestamps and user identities?
How many alerts would the proposed rules generate, and what proportion are actionable?
Can the controls detect known historical errors without relying on information unavailable at the time?
What access, retention and OR requirements apply to the intended monitoring scope?

tasks.short: Maintain site budgets and explain actual spending against the approved plan.

today.trigger: A budget round or periodic actual-versus-budget reporting deadline.
steps: Retrieve approved budgets and export actuals from AFAS.
Align periods, accounts and cost centres across Excel workbooks.
Calculate variances and investigate material differences with budget owners.
Update proposed budget assumptions with FP&A and the Controller.
Issue the comparison report and record approved changes.
drudgery: Pasting actuals into budget templates.
Repairing formulas and mapping differences.
Combining manager submissions and tracking versions.
today.time_sinks: Reconciling different budget versions and repeatedly collecting explanations for the same variance.

lenses.faster: Refresh actuals against a locked approved budget and calculate variances automatically. Draft commentary only for material movements and reused explanations that remain valid.
lenses.autonomous: Publish routine comparisons after reconciliation checks pass, routing missing mappings and material exceptions for review. Budget changes remain subject to approval.
lenses.ambitious: Give every site owner a consistent view of controllable spending and early warnings of likely overruns.
lenses.joy: Remove template consolidation and formula repair. Keep discussions about spending choices and realistic plans.
lenses.options: Compare spending freezes, deferred purchases and different agency staffing assumptions. Separate one-off effects from changes that continue into later periods.
lenses.altitude: Own the budget structure, version controls and variance standards instead of maintaining individual spreadsheets.
reach: FP&A: prepare validated actual-versus-plan reporting.
Controller: maintain budget version and reconciliation controls.
Site managers: provide consistent spending forecasts and action tracking.

tasks.human_edge: Negotiate credible budgets, distinguish timing effects from structural problems and challenge explanations without weakening accountability.
tasks.pattern_why: Approved budgets, mappings and actuals support checkable calculations without a model. An optional LLM step can draft commentary, while people retain budget decisions.

in_practice.trigger: The nightly extract passes validation or an approved budget version becomes effective.
steps: Load actuals and the approved budget, checking totals, period status and mapping completeness.
Calculate site and account variances using controlled formulas and thresholds.
Publish validated comparisons automatically and flag incomplete or material exceptions.
Draft source-linked commentary for accountant and budget-owner review.
Store approved explanations and separately process authorized budget revisions.
in_practice.human_gate: Routine reconciled comparisons can publish automatically. People approve commentary requiring judgment, new assumptions and every change to the approved budget.
systems: Approved enterprise LLM service for optional drafting
data_needed: Approved budgets with version and effective date.
Actuals by period, site, cost centre and account.
Account mappings, allocation rules and materiality thresholds.
Budget owners and approved prior explanations.
in_practice.logs_to: A SharePoint budget register linked to report versions, reconciliation results, exceptions and approved revisions.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports actual-versus-budget measures, refreshes and drill-down reporting.
Versioned mappings and reconciliation rules can automate recurring budget comparisons.
The proposed workflow, 65% time saving and 2.86 times speedup are planning estimates.

risks: An incorrect budget version can produce plausible but wrong variances.
Late postings and changing allocations can distort site comparisons.
Automated commentary can confuse timing differences with permanent savings.
Reports overlap with FP&A responsibilities unless ownership is agreed.
research_questions: Is there one approved budget source with controlled versions and stable account mappings?
Which reconciliations must pass before a comparison can publish automatically?
How much current effort concerns data preparation versus negotiation and explanation?
Can a pilot reproduce the accepted report and reduce total review time?

tasks.short: Check payroll taxes, social insurance premiums and payroll liabilities against Dutch rules and both CAOs.

today.trigger: A payroll reconciliation, year-end review, premium decision or audit request.
steps: Obtain AFAS payroll results, relevant contract fields and payroll-to-ledger reconciliations.
Collect current tax guidance, premium decisions and applicable CAO provisions.
Sample payroll calculations and check relevant classifications, allowances and liabilities.
Investigate differences with the Payroll Specialist and HR.
Document findings and submit corrections for authorized review.
systems: AFAS Profit HR, payroll and general ledger
drudgery: Matching payroll reports to ledger postings.
Repeating premium and allowance calculations.
Locating the rule version that applied to a specific pay period.
today.time_sinks: Resolving rule applicability across employment situations, the transport CAO and the warehouse CAO.

lenses.faster: Reconcile payroll totals to the ledger and recalculate selected premiums using dated, approved rules. Present differences with the relevant employee fields and rule references.
lenses.autonomous: Run checks when a payroll run is finalized or an approved rule changes. Route exceptions to the Payroll Specialist and accountant.
lenses.ambitious: Check all eligible payroll records rather than a small sample, and quantify the exposure from each confirmed configuration error.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated report matching and arithmetic. Keep interpretation of difficult cases and prevention of recurring errors.
lenses.options: Model the financial effect of alternative classifications where the legal treatment is uncertain. Have the Payroll Specialist or adviser resolve the correct treatment before correction.
lenses.altitude: Maintain a payroll assurance framework with dated rules, coverage checks and evidence of corrections.
reach: Payroll Specialist: provide independent payroll-to-ledger assurance.
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: quantify allowance and premium effects.
Controller: support payroll liability and provision reviews.

tasks.human_edge: Interpret Dutch payroll obligations and CAO scope with specialists, resolve ambiguous employment facts and take responsibility for audit conclusions.
tasks.pattern_why: Reconciliations and recalculations are deterministic once applicability is settled. People must approve legal interpretations and payroll corrections; an LLM may help locate clauses but cannot establish the rule.

in_practice.trigger: A finalized payroll run, year-end reconciliation or approved change to payroll rules.
steps: Retrieve the minimum payroll and contract fields needed and reconcile them to the general ledger.
Apply approved, effective-dated checks for wage tax, AWf, Aof, Whk and other relevant liabilities.
Test applicable CAO allowances and financial sick-pay obligations where included in scope.
Create evidence packs for exceptions and quantify potential corrections.
Record specialist decisions and verify authorized corrections in a subsequent payroll run.
in_practice.human_gate: The Payroll Specialist validates applicability and corrections; material or disputed tax and CAO interpretations go to the responsible adviser and authorized finance approver.
systems: Controlled calculation workbook or rules service
data_needed: Payroll components, taxable bases and ledger postings.
Relevant contract type, hours and CAO assignment.
Current employer premium decisions and effective-dated Dutch rules.
Approved allowance and sick-pay rules, without medical diagnoses.
Agency agreements where liability concerning flex workers is in scope.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted payroll assurance register containing rule versions, exception references, decisions and correction evidence.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit includes payroll processing and financial administration.
Independent premium recalculations and payroll-to-ledger checks can use approved, effective-dated rules.
The proposed workflow, 50% time saving and two times speedup remain untested.

risks: US workers' compensation concepts do not map directly to Dutch employee insurance and employer liabilities.
Outdated premium rates or incorrect contract and CAO classifications can invalidate calculations.
Payroll and absence information require strict AVG/GDPR access and data minimization; medical details are unnecessary.
Wet verbetering poortwachter obligations require specialist interpretation where relevant to financial liabilities; accounting checks cannot establish case compliance alone.
Responsibility for agency workers must follow actual contracts and applicable law.
research_questions: Which Dutch premium, liability and CAO checks are currently performed, and which are already covered by AFAS?
Can the necessary fields be exported without diagnoses, BSNs or unrelated personnel information?
Who approves effective-dated rules and resolves disputed classifications?
Does a historical rerun detect known payroll errors without duplicating the Payroll Specialist's existing controls?

tasks.short: Advise HR and Finance on the financial effects of pay, benefits and accounting system choices.

today.trigger: HR or Finance requests advice on a benefit, compensation proposal, system change or longer-term tax question.
steps: Clarify the decision, affected groups, timing and financial constraints.
Gather relevant costs, policies, CAO provisions and system information.
Calculate financial effects and identify questions for HR, Payroll or external advisers.
Prepare options and discuss tradeoffs with the decision owner.
Record the advice, assumptions and agreed next steps.
drudgery: Finding current policies and earlier advice.
Recalculating similar cost comparisons.
Turning meeting notes into a decision paper.
today.time_sinks: Clarifying the real question and obtaining authoritative answers about tax, CAO and implementation constraints.

lenses.faster: Retrieve approved policies, calculate options with controlled formulas and draft the decision paper. The accountant spends more time testing assumptions with HR and Finance.
lenses.autonomous: A structured request can trigger document retrieval, missing-information checks and a preliminary cost comparison. Advice remains led by the accountant.
lenses.ambitious: Give smaller pay, benefit and system proposals a proper financial assessment before commitments are made.
lenses.joy: Remove document searching and repeated drafting. Keep the collaborative work of finding a practical answer.
lenses.options: Prepare several affordable designs with different employer costs, employee effects and implementation demands. Mark legal and tax questions that need specialist confirmation.
lenses.altitude: Develop reusable decision methods and track whether approved proposals deliver their expected financial effects.
reach: Compensation and Benefits Specialist: provide employer cost modelling.
HRIS Analyst: assess financial controls in proposed system changes.
Finance Director: prepare questions and calculations for external tax advisers.

tasks.human_edge: Understand stakeholder concerns, explain tradeoffs and recognize the boundary between financial analysis and specialist HR, legal or tax advice.
tasks.pattern_why: The core work is advice and discussion. AI can prepare evidence, drafts and alternatives, while the accountant leads the engagement and checks specialist conclusions.

in_practice.trigger: An accountant accepts a scoped advice request from HR or Finance.
steps: Capture the decision, affected population and required approvals.
Retrieve current approved policies and relevant financial inputs with source dates.
Calculate comparable options and identify unresolved tax, CAO and system questions.
Draft a decision paper and review it with the accountant and relevant specialists.
Record the approved advice and schedule a check of actual financial effects.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant owns the advice; HR, Payroll, external advisers and authorized decision makers validate their respective areas before implementation.
data_needed: Scoped request and decision authority.
Current policies and applicable CAO provisions.
Aggregated workforce costs and proposed benefit terms.
System requirements, implementation estimates and authoritative specialist advice.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint advice register containing sources, assumptions, reviewed options, specialist input and decisions.

evidence.claim: An LLM can draft option papers from supplied material, with human checking of calculations and legal claims.
The proposed workflow, 35% time saving and 1.54 times speedup are untested estimates.

risks: Generated text can sound authoritative while misreading tax or CAO provisions.
Benefit and employment-policy changes may require OR involvement or consent, depending on their scope.
Individual compensation data must remain restricted under AVG/GDPR.
Private estate planning falls outside the assumed internal accountant remit and should go to a qualified external adviser.
Using AI to make individual employment decisions would require a separate legal and EU AI Act assessment.
research_questions: Which advice requests actually reach the accountants, and which belong to HR, C&B or external advisers?
Are current policies and specialist opinions stored with clear owners and effective dates?
Does drafting support reduce total preparation time after specialist review is included?
Which proposal types require OR involvement and which approval routes apply?

tasks.short: Check financial controls and reconciliations before a new system or interface goes live.

today.trigger: A planned change to AFAS, a finance interface, payroll processing or an agency data feed.
steps: Read requirements, process descriptions and proposed financial controls.
Identify failure cases and agree acceptance criteria with process owners.
Inspect configuration and run sample transactions in a test environment.
Reconcile results, review access and document defects.
Retest fixes and provide a financial readiness recommendation.
systems: AFAS Profit test environment if available
Relevant agency portal or interface test environment
drudgery: Turning requirements into repetitive test cases.
Comparing transaction outputs and ledger totals manually.
Collecting screenshots and rebuilding evidence after each change.
today.time_sinks: Obtaining a representative test environment and following defects through correction and retesting.

lenses.faster: Draft test cases from requirements and automate repeatable reconciliations. Assemble evidence and defect summaries as tests run.
lenses.autonomous: Rerun approved checks after a test build or configuration change and flag differences from accepted results.
lenses.ambitious: Test rare failures such as duplicate imports, interrupted batches, period boundaries and agency corrections before they affect a close.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated comparisons and evidence formatting. Keep the reasoning about how a process can fail and whether controls are sufficient.
lenses.options: Compare migration approaches, reconciliation controls and rollback choices against explicit financial acceptance criteria.
lenses.altitude: Own reusable financial acceptance standards and regression checks across finance system changes.
reach: HRIS Analyst: test payroll-to-finance interfaces.
Controller: maintain financial acceptance and segregation-of-duties requirements.
Bookkeepers: validate invoice and payment process changes.

tasks.human_edge: Recognize missing requirements, judge material control gaps and challenge readiness claims independently of the implementation team.
tasks.pattern_why: AI can propose cases and write test scripts, while deterministic checks compare results. The accountant must lead scope, evidence assessment and the readiness recommendation.

in_practice.trigger: A finance-related change reaches acceptance testing with documented requirements.
steps: Map requirements and financial risks to proposed tests and expected results.
Have the accountant approve coverage, fixtures and materiality criteria.
Run approved tests in an isolated environment using synthetic or minimized data.
Collect outputs and reconciliation evidence, then draft defects for validation.
Retest fixes and prepare a source-linked readiness recommendation.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant approves test coverage and findings; the accountable system and finance owners authorize go-live and any accepted residual risks.
data_needed: Requirements, interface specifications and configuration versions.
Expected accounting entries and control totals.
Approved role and permission matrix.
Representative test cases, cutover plan and rollback criteria.
in_practice.logs_to: A SharePoint change dossier linking requirements, script versions, test evidence, defects, retests and sign-offs.

evidence.claim: AI can assist with test-case drafting and script development; repeatable reconciliation tests can run without a model.
The proposed workflow, 40% time saving and 1.67 times speedup depend on usable test environments and specifications.

risks: Tests generated from incomplete requirements can miss the same weaknesses as the implementation.
Expected results need independent approval to avoid testing code against its own assumptions.
Production payroll or banking data could leak into test evidence without data minimization.
Writing production configuration or running live payment tests exceeds this review workflow.
Internal readiness review does not replace independent statutory assurance where required.
research_questions: Which systems provide representative test environments and repeatable imports?
Are expected ledger entries and control totals specified independently of the implementation?
Which past implementation defects would the proposed tests have caught?
Can evidence generation and retesting save time without reducing independent review?

tasks.short: Explain asset use and audit findings to management and recommend practical changes.

today.trigger: A management review, completed audit or question about site assets and operating costs.
steps: Gather asset balances, depreciation, available usage data and audit findings.
Reconcile financial figures and confirm operational definitions with site owners.
Assess underuse, recurring control weaknesses and potential improvements.
Prepare a management report with recommendations and financial effects.
Discuss decisions and track agreed actions.
drudgery: Refreshing charts and copying numbers into reports.
Combining findings from different files.
Reformatting action lists and chasing updates.
today.time_sinks: Finding reliable usage measures and turning financial observations into recommendations managers can act on.

lenses.faster: Refresh reconciled figures and draft a management brief linked to the supporting evidence. Repeated chart production and action-list assembly disappear.
lenses.autonomous: Prepare a draft after a reporting cutoff or approved audit finding, and flag overdue actions. The accountant decides what management needs to hear.
lenses.ambitious: Provide each site with a consistent review of asset economics and control improvements, then check whether agreed actions delivered value.
lenses.joy: Remove presentation maintenance and status chasing. Keep recommendations, constructive challenge and discussions with site management.
lenses.options: Compare repair, replacement, redeployment and disposal where relevant data exists. Show financial effects alongside capacity, safety and service constraints.
lenses.altitude: Own the quality of management evidence and the process for turning findings into verified improvements.
reach: Controller: prepare management control reporting.
FP&A: develop financial comparisons for asset decisions.
Site management: track improvement actions and their financial results.

tasks.human_edge: Choose the message, handle disagreement and weigh financial returns against operational reliability, safety and service commitments.
tasks.pattern_why: Reconciled measures and draft reports can be prepared automatically, but recommendation quality depends on operational context and management discussion.

in_practice.trigger: A scheduled management review or completion of approved audit findings.
steps: Load reconciled asset figures, confirmed findings and available operational usage data.
Calculate agreed measures and flag missing or inconsistent usage inputs.
Draft a concise report separating observations, hypotheses and proposed actions.
Have the accountant validate recommendations and discuss them with management.
Record decisions, assign action owners and verify results at the next review.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant approves the report and recommendations; management authorizes operational changes, investment or asset disposal.
data_needed: Asset register or equivalent records, balances and depreciation.
Maintenance, leasing and operating costs where available.
Reliable usage, throughput or downtime measures from operational owners.
Confirmed audit findings and management responses.
Investment criteria and action owners.
in_practice.logs_to: A SharePoint management action register linked to report versions, evidence, decisions and measured results.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports financial dashboards and comparisons using prepared asset and operational data.
An LLM can draft a management brief from verified measures and confirmed findings.
The proposed workflow, 45% time saving and 1.82 times speedup are untested estimates.

risks: Asset book value and depreciation do not establish physical utilization or replacement need.
Operational usage data is not among the specified systems and may be unavailable.
Recommendations based only on cost can undermine safety, resilience or customer service.
Generated summaries can overstate tentative audit findings or expected savings.
research_questions: Which assets need review, and are reliable usage and maintenance measures available?
Can each proposed recommendation be traced to confirmed evidence and an accountable owner?
How much report preparation time remains after reconciliation and management review?
How will the team verify realized savings and operational effects after a decision?

role.altitude: The accountant becomes the owner of reliable financial evidence: reconciled inputs, repeatable controls, approved assumptions and clear explanations that help the business close and forecast confidently.
reach: Prepare reconciled actuals and scenarios for FP&A.
Maintain control evidence, exceptions and remediation tracking for the Controller.
Provide independent payroll-to-ledger and premium checks for the Payroll Specialist.
Define financial acceptance tests with the HRIS Analyst and system owners.
Support site managers with spending and asset decision analysis.
role.ceiling_note: These seven tasks total 217.8 hours per FTE annually, about 13.6% of the role. The estimates imply roughly 220 hours of annual capacity across both accountants, about EUR 15,400 at EUR 70/hour; this is potential capacity, not cash savings, before implementation and maintenance costs. Current workflows are inferred, and savings and speedups require measurement across the complete task, including review and automated processing. Nightly data, unavailable operational inputs and specialist approvals limit turnaround; the rest of the role is unassessed.
skills_to_grow: Design reconciliations, effective-dated rules and control thresholds.
Use Power BI, Power Query or SQL to inspect data lineage and exceptions.
Maintain controlled forecast and scenario models.
Check generated explanations against financial evidence.
Apply Dutch payroll, CAO and financial-control knowledge with the relevant specialists.
Design acceptance tests and assess evidence independently.
Explain uncertainty and negotiate action with site managers.
Apply AVG/GDPR access controls and recognize when OR or EU AI Act assessment is needed.
role.ambitious_version: Run a shared financial evidence process across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo that produces reconciled actuals, early control warnings and transparent forecast assumptions. Use the released capacity to resolve close blockers sooner, improve source data and verify whether management actions deliver results. Agree ownership with the Controller, FP&A and Payroll, and judge progress through close days, forecast accuracy, audit adjustments and exception-resolution time.
